keyEvents.text: Michal Sadílek (Slavia Prague) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Ayoze Pérez (Villarreal).
Ange N'Guessan (Slavia Prague) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Renato Veiga (Villarreal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Slavia Prague 0, Villarreal 0.
Substitution, Villarreal. Santi Comesaña replaces Alberto Moleiro.
Goal! Slavia Prague 0, Villarreal 1. Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Ayoze Pérez.
Substitution, Slavia Prague. Oskar Kubiak replaces Tomás Vlcek.
Substitution, Slavia Prague. Pavel Kacor replaces Ange N'Guessan.
Substitution, Villarreal. Georges Mikautadze replaces Ayoze Pérez.
Substitution, Villarreal. Alex Freeman replaces Carlos Maciá.
Substitution, Slavia Prague. Ivan Schranz replaces Emmanuel Ayaosi.
Substitution, Villarreal. Carlos Romero replaces Sergi Cardona.
Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Carlos Romero (Villarreal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Slavia Prague 0, Villarreal 1.
